title: Second marginal of a correlated Gaussian
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the law obtained by taking independent standard normal random variables $U,V$ and setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$. Then the second coordinate $Y$ has the standard normal distribution.
